title: 120 Rae Lane

Property Site: https://view.paradym.com/v/120-Rae-Lane-Jarrell-TX-76537/4969077

120 Rae Lane
Jarrell, TX 76537
$990,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,949 SF, MLS# 613733

Tired of the city life? Try stretching your legs on this beautiful piece of property. It's 18.497 acres of green grass, a lovely home, and a 30'X40' workshop (or a man cave, quilt barn or whatever you choose). This home boasts 1949 sq. ft with 3BR and 2BA.  Washday blues are made easier in the bright and large laundry room! There is even a Laundry line in the backyard to hang out your clothes if you choose. The huge wood burning fireplace in the spacious Family room will create an ambiance that your family and friends will enjoy. The dining area is next to the kitchen. You can cook or bake while visiting with friends. The large patio and deck are a second entertaining spot in this home. The raised garden beds in the backyard are now producing vegetables. The orchard has peach, pear, nectarine, apple, fig, apricot, and plum trees. The green house next to the metal workshop will be good for your plants during the cold months. This property is fully fenced with an electric gate. Call your favorite realtor today to see this property. Your family, children, and pets will approve!

2 full bath
